assertions: Shared XML border handlers do not import Editeng items; application item mapping is owned by Writer.
Existing helper behavior and consumers are preserved without old-path reexports or cycle exceptions.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task143 corrects the reversed XML attribute-container prerequisite instead of adding a cycle exception. Native xmloff border handlers use published UNO BorderLine2/BorderLineStyle; existing Writer importBoxProperties/exportBoxProperties/exportBorderShorthand adapters move to Writer xmlimpit/xmlexpit responsibility boundaries. All10actual consumers migrate with no old-path compatibility reexports. Three moved function bodies are unchanged; shared handler/token bodies differ only by the equivalent published enum owner. Shared pure token spelling is exposed once to avoid duplicating the source style map or inventing a native class method. The xmloff-to-editeng edge is removed and rejected; SAL/o3tl and all cycle-rejection functions stay unchanged. Native editeng-to-xmloff dependency is not added until actual XML attribute implementation. Current browser-shaped item mapping remains explicit and not certified as the full native Any/item mapper, and is not frozen as a deliberate I/O deviation. Existing statuses/classification/history and deliberate save/open/recovery exceptions retained; no broad parity promotion or native memory engine.
